mentions.name: Euromillions data analyzer
mentions.description: A Python app that analyzes historical Euromillions draw numbers, offering statistical analysis features to examine patterns and bias across past lottery draws. It was built because official sources only provide about 6 months of historical draw data, while the app covers all past draws.
mentions.problem: Official lottery sources provide only about 6 months of historical draw data, making it difficult to analyze all past Euromillions draws.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Euromillions data analyzer: https://github.com/benb0jangles/euromillions_analyser

My creation this week, i hope some find it interesting and fun. Last night I was bored so I created a python app to analyse historical euromillions draw numbers. I added tons of features and some statistical analysis features to examine patterns and bias.
